Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • The "Sending…" card shows who the message is going to and a preview again while you're reading a different conversation.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • When no conversation is open, the "Sending…" card now sits neatly in the middle of the reading pane and shows who the message is going to and a preview, instead of a bare strip floating above "Select a conversation".

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Unsubscribe in one click more often. When a sender's unsubscribe page asks you to confirm, Normal Mail now loads the page in the background and presses the confirm button for you, then checks that the page says you're unsubscribed. When a sender asks for an unsubscribe email, it's sent for you automatically. A page only opens in your browser if it needs something from you, such as typing your email address or signing in.
